points.point: Why two posts after AI edit of scheduled post
points.sentence: Two posts for what should have been an edit most likely means the AI tool also called blotato_create_post.

points.point: How to avoid duplicate / edit in place
points.sentence: Tell it in so many words: use only blotato_update_schedule, and do not create a new post.

verdict.reason: The customer asked Claude to edit a scheduled post and got a duplicate, which is the exact situation this entry explains and fixes.
